name: conductor-bmad
description: Adopt Factory and BMAD in one repository with upstream-only BMAD enforcement and immutable Factory intake.

interface.shortDescription: Route BMAD evidence into Factory safely.
interface.longDescription: Diagnose uniform Factory/BMAD adoption, enforce the upstream-only BMAD authority boundary, audit installed capabilities, reconcile brownfield evidence, promote immutable snapshots, and seed fail-closed Factory intake controls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Diagnose this repository and tell me the next safe Factory BMAD action.

skills.description: Diagnose the five Factory and BMAD adoption states and return exactly one safe next action without changing the repository.
Preview or apply a pinned BMAD 6.10.0 Core+BMM Claude Code bootstrap with exact approval, audit, and receipts.
Audit installed BMAD modules, commands, skills, agents, hooks, configuration, versions, policy coverage, and brownfield evidence without mutation.
Preview, create, reuse, or safely roll back an immutable reviewed BMAD evidence snapshot for Factory intake.
Preview or seed the Factory BMAD policy, embedded-checklist brief template, and fail-closed project preflight adapter.
Preview or seed the inert adapter contracts (adapter config schema, lane policy schema and JSON, authority policy) so contract-lint can validate a declared BMAD adapter before intake.
